source.description:
**This is a cell phone model.**

This phone has a plastic back cover, and a screen. Also, there is a fingerprint sensor on the back cover. The screen is made in black color, but it can be replaced with any image you want: you just need to replace a uv island of the screen in diffuse texture. All cameras are made as a texture to save polygons. The model is made similar to one of the Huawei models. But there are no brand identification marks on the back cover. So, this model is suitable for use in games, as it contains a quite low polygon count. You can also use this phone in your projects, commercial animations and so on. Real size model, high resolution textures, this is a PBR model. The mesh consists of triangles, overlapping uv map to save uv space.

Total count of tris: 2,706
Total count of vertices: 1,453

Dimensions:
Height: 16 cm
Width: 8 cm

Including formats:
Blend
Fbx
Obj

Created in Blender 3.2
